name: King EX90
description: King EX90 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX90R digital reverb (1988). Eight modes (L.HALL, LOFT, L.ROOM, GATE, S.HALL, S.ROOM, PLATE, REVERSE), predelay 0-200 ms, decay 0.3-15 s or gate time, high cut 1-16 kHz, separate DRY and REVERB levels, overload light, EFFECT switch with a natural tail, and a 12-BIT switch for the original's 12-bit 39 kHz sound.
author: The Disk King
